StaleDaysHint: Locations not refreshed for this many days are marked stale.
HideNamesHint: For sharing screenshots: every character, retainer, free company and vessel shows an invented name instead, in this window and in /mogvault find. Each one keeps its invented name, and no two are the same. Item tooltips, saved data and IPC keep the real names.
ItemTooltipsHint: Adds where the item is stored and how many you have to the game's own item tooltip.
ForgetFreeCompanyDaysHint: Deletes a free company's data once none of your characters has been in it for this many days (you left, or it was disbanded). Characters count as members until they log in again. 0 keeps everything. Applied the next time the plugin starts.
ResetDataTooltip: Hold Ctrl and Shift and click
ResetDataHint: Deletes every saved character, retainer and free company. Backups are kept. The character you are logged in with is captured again, like after a fresh install.
BackupsHint: On the first plugin start of each day, all MogVault data is zipped into the "backups" folder before anything new is saved.
BackupDaysHint: How many daily backups to keep (1-30). Older ones are deleted when a new one is made.
NewNamesHint: Gives everyone different invented names, e.g. if a name ever came up in a screenshot you shared.
